evidence.title: Venture Firm Behind Chip Startup Groq Targets $10 Billion Megafund

occurrences.quote_span: Disruptive, a venture-capital firm that placed winning bets on chip startup Groq and open-source AI model maker Reflection AI, is raising up to $10 billion for a new fund, joining an elite class of Silicon Valley investors that run megafunds.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Disruptive

occurrences.quote_span: A relatively small group of venture funds manage megafunds, which PitchBook defines as funds exceeding $500 million.
occurrences.speaker: PitchBook
occurrences.subject: Disruptive

occurrences.checkable_against: Disruptive investment vehicle and transaction records
occurrences.quote_span: Until recently, the Dallas-based firm invested largely through special-purpose vehicles, pooling investor money on a deal-by-deal basis.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Disruptive

occurrences.quote_span: It has also made investments in Databricks, defense tech company Shield AI and voice AI startup ElevenLabs.
